as_told.title: Rossi taken by a blue energy humanoid

plain: Dave Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics, says that in 2021, at his home, he was taken in his sleep by a humanoid figure made of something like blue energy. He tells it in nearly the same words on two different episodes, though the second time he gives no date or place.
